summary.title: Knight Rider threat model
summary.description: Threat model of Knight Rider, a read-only, allowlist-only fetcher of Tor onion services and I2P eepsites for an AI consumer, in three isolation tiers (Tor Browser, container, Whonix). Drawn from issues #1, #2, #4 and #8 and the maintainer's wiki, before the design document exists; a draft for the maintainer and a cyber-tier review, not an audit. Narrative in docs/threat-model.md.

threats.title: K16: Intelligence integrity: lures, cloaked or poisoned pages
threats.description: Asset at risk: the integrity of OSINT conclusions. Actor class: an operator who wants to mislead. Prerequisites: an operator who wants to mislead. Rank 16. Full entry: docs/threat-model.md, K16.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Provenance and time in every result; content flagged operator-controlled; no automated action on content; discovered leads only recorded. Verification: Planned test: every result carries the provenance header. Maintainer review. Residual: Judgment stays human. Status is Open: the design is not built; every verification marked planned is a Phase 1 test.

data.name: Network adversary
data.description: Watches both ends, runs relays or floodfills, controls an AS.

threats.title: K14: Network adversary: correlation, malicious relays or floodfills, honeypot operators
threats.description: Asset at risk: unlinkability of the maintainer and a destination. Actor class: an observer of both ends or the operator of a relay, floodfill or allowlisted service. Prerequisites: position at both ends or a controlled relay; sustained effort. Rank 14. Full entry: docs/threat-model.md, K14.
threats.mitigation: Accepted. Client-only (no onion service or hidden service); no long-lived services; few small requests; unpredictable timing; no logged-in behavior. Verification: Not testable in this repository; stated as a non-goal in the design. Residual: Accepted by the maintainer; reopen if the tool begins to publish or to run on a schedule. Status is Open: the design is not built; every verification marked planned is a Phase 1 test.

data.name: Tier control wrapper

data.name: Fetch sandbox
data.description: Tor Browser profile, worker container, or Whonix Workstation; parser and sanitizer run here.

threats.title: K02: Sandbox escape per tier
threats.description: Asset at risk: the host and everything the maintainer's account reaches (credentials, repositories, the Claude login). Actor class: a page author delivering an exploit chain against the browser and then the container runtime or hypervisor. Prerequisites: a working chain; light for T1, heavy for T2 and T3. Rank 2. Full entry: docs/threat-model.md, K02.
threats.mitigation: Partial. No secret, token, repository, socket or host directory reachable inside any sandbox; non-root sandbox user; ephemeral sessions; browsers kept current. T1 only under a dedicated OS account; T2 rootless, capabilities dropped, no new privileges, read-only root, no runtime socket, internal-only network; T3 no shared folders, clipboard or device passthrough, domain definitions generated by the wrapper. Verification: Planned test: the wrapper generates container and domain definitions and the test asserts privileged mode, host mounts, runtime sockets, added capabilities, device passthrough and shared folders are absent; after approval, a self-check lists what the sandbox can see and reach. Residual: An unpatched browser or hypervisor flaw defeats this; T1 is the weakest tier by decision. If breached: T1 gives the user's account, T2 the local proxy ports and forged output (or the host on a runtime escape), T3 forged output and the Workstation without the real address (project claim) or the host on a hypervisor escape. Status is Open: the design is not built; every verification marked planned is a Phase 1 test.

threats.title: K12: Ephemerality fails: state survives a run or links runs
threats.description: Asset at risk: unlinkability of fetches and the clean state of the sandbox. Actor class: a prior hostile page, or a failed revert. Prerequisites: an earlier hostile page or a revert error. Rank 12. Full entry: docs/threat-model.md, K12.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Revert after every run and verify by a state marker, not an exit code; fresh browser profile per run in T1; throwaway containers in T2; per-run circuits for Tor; design states that I2P visits are linkable in the Whonix path. Verification: Planned test: a revert that does not report success blocks the next fetch; a marker written in one run is absent in the next on the stubbed backend. Residual: I2P linkability through Tor stays (Whonix wiki). Status is Open: the design is not built; every verification marked planned is a Phase 1 test.

data.name: Tor and I2P daemons or Gateway
data.description: The only part with a path to the networks.

threats.title: K03: Data leakage of the real IP or identity
threats.description: Asset at risk: the maintainer's real network location and identity. Actor class: a page author, or a client bug or mis-wired network. Prerequisites: any page that triggers a request; a bug or a mistake in wiring. Rank 3. Full entry: docs/threat-model.md, K03.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Worker has no route except the local proxy; remote name resolution through the proxy; no external viewers, plugins or document handlers; non-text types refused; design states whether I2P is reached directly (host visible to I2P peers) or through Tor (Whonix-documented, with linkability); i2pd set not to publish or relay where configuration allows. Verification: Planned test: generated worker network configuration has no default route and no resolver; a recording stub proxy sees only remote-resolved names; unresolvable names fail closed; after approval, a direct connection attempt from the worker fails. Residual: T1: any browser flaw can leak; all tiers: the local network sees Tor or I2P use. Status is Open: the design is not built; every verification marked planned is a Phase 1 test.

data.name: Host and hypervisor
data.description: Local machine now; later the always-on box or a Proxmox VM.

threats.title: K10: The Whonix host question
threats.description: Asset at risk: the host's credentials, including the Claude login if the box is shared. Actor class: a guest or hypervisor attacker, or the holder of the wrapper's hypervisor credential. Prerequisites: a hypervisor escape (heavy) or the wrapper credential in the wrong hands (light). Rank 10. Full entry: docs/threat-model.md, K10.
threats.mitigation: Open. Prefer a host used only for these VMs; if the always-on box is shared, keep other credentials out of reach of the VM-running account or use a separate hypervisor host; the wrapper connects as a dedicated account with rights only on named domains over an authenticated encrypted channel; host is configuration; Proxmox would be a separate driver (unverified). Verification: Maintainer checklist before first run: credentials present on the host, account that runs the VMs, access-control listing for it. Planned test: the wrapper refuses a domain name not in its configuration. Residual: Virtualization enlarges the trusted computing base; this is the maintainer's decision, not a code fix. Status is Open: the design is not built; every verification marked planned is a Phase 1 test.

data.name: Allowlist (private file)
data.description: Read from a configured path; never in the repository; agents never edit it.

threats.title: K04: Allowlist bypass, tampering or widening
threats.description: Asset at risk: default deny, and the privacy of what the maintainer researches. Actor class: a page author (look-alike, redirect, persuasion) or a same-user process (file edit). Prerequisites: a parser difference or redirect; same-user code execution; a persuaded maintainer. Rank 4. Full entry: docs/threat-model.md, K04.
threats.mitigation: Partial. One canonical host, port and scheme; exact match; unparseable input rejected; redirects re-checked per hop and capped; no verb edits the allowlist; refuse a group- or world-writable file or one inside a repository; allowlist digest on every log line; promotion is a human act outside any AI-callable tool; denial text gives no hint to widen. Verification: Planned test: table of hostile destination forms denied and valid forms passed; redirect-to-forbidden and loop tests; startup test with a writable file and a file inside a repository. Command: stat -c '%a %U' on the allowlist path shows no group or world write. Residual: A same-user writer can still change the file; the digest makes it visible, not impossible. Signing off-box would close more. Status is Open: the design is not built; every verification marked planned is a Phase 1 test.

data.name: Request log
data.description: Destinations, times, sizes, allowlist digest; no bodies.

threats.title: K07: Data leakage from the log and stored data
threats.description: Asset at risk: the record of what the maintainer looked at, and in Phase 2 service identifiers. Actor class: a local reader, a backup or sync job, or an accidental commit. Prerequisites: local read access as the user, or a mistaken sync or commit. Rank 7. Full entry: docs/threat-model.md, K07.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Log and database outside the repository and outside synced directories; mode 0600 in a 0700 directory; no bodies, query strings, cookies or headers; bounded retention with a purge; encrypted volume; refuse a log path inside a repository. Verification: Planned test: log lines hold only the defined fields; a log path inside a git work tree is refused. Command: ./scripts/check-addresses.sh exits 0 (exists). Command: git check-ignore -v on the state directory shows the rule. Residual: Same-user read access and manual copies remain. Status is Open: the design is not built; every verification marked planned is a Phase 1 test.

data.name: Discovery metadata (Phase 2)
data.description: Identifier, type, status, first and last seen, category, source, confidence.

threats.title: K08: Second-order prompt injection through stored titles and log lines
threats.description: Asset at risk: the consuming AI session and the integrity of the store. Actor class: a page author who sets a title or short field. Prerequisites: a page that sets the field and a later read of the store. Rank 8. Full entry: docs/threat-model.md, K08.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Fields normalized, length-capped and stripped of control characters at write time; log format escapes newlines and delimiters; every read path returns stored strings in the K01 envelope as untrusted; counts and categories computed by code. Verification: Planned test: a title with a newline, a fake log line, a fake envelope and control characters is stored; the log still parses one line per event; a read returns it escaped inside the envelope. Residual: Plain-language instructions again pass. Status is Open: the design is not built; every verification marked planned is a Phase 1 test.

data.name: Public repository and issues
data.description: Code, docs, placeholder examples; address check in CI.

threats.title: K17: Data leakage into the public repository: addresses, allowlist content, unfixed detail
threats.description: Asset at risk: repository cleanliness and the maintainer's safety. Actor class: a contributor or an agent drafting text. Prerequisites: a mistake. Rank 17. Full entry: docs/threat-model.md, K17.
threats.mitigation: Implemented in part. scripts/check-addresses.sh over every tracked file in CI through tests/run.sh; placeholder-only example allowlist; SECURITY.md routes unfixed detail to the private tracker; this model names classes, not steps. Verification: Command: ./tests/run.sh prints 'all checks passed' and exits 0 (exists). Unit test: tests/test_check_addresses.sh. Residual: The check finds address-shaped strings, not an allowlist described in words; review stays human. Status is Open: the design is not built; every verification marked planned is a Phase 1 test.

data.name: Tool call
data.description: One destination per call; no free-form command text.

data.name: Sanitized result envelope
data.description: Provenance header plus quoted untrusted text body.

threats.title: K01: Prompt injection: page text aimed at the consuming AI
threats.description: Asset at risk: the consuming AI session and everything its tools reach (repositories, tokens, shell). Actor class: a page author or any third party who can place text on a fetched page. Prerequisites: text on a fetched page; no credential, no exploit. Rank 1. Full entry: docs/threat-model.md, K01.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Fixed envelope built by the tool with provenance and an untrusted-data statement; plain-text-only output with markup, hidden text, control, bidirectional and zero-width characters removed or made visible; no verb that writes, posts or follows a link; output cap; consumer-side advice to read results in a session with no write tools and return a short structured summary. Verification: Planned hermetic test: fixture corpus of page classes through the sanitizer (output has no markup or control characters, envelope intact and unique, cap holds, fake envelope text escaped); test that the fetch verb refuses a destination found only in page text; Daybreak-tier review of the envelope and sanitizer. Residual: Plain-language instructions survive any sanitizer; closing this depends on consumer-side privilege separation outside this repository. Status is Open: the design is not built; every verification marked planned is a Phase 1 test.

data.name: Verb and arguments
data.description: Closed verb set with validated arguments.

threats.title: K06: Tool abuse: restricted verbs turned into a shell
threats.description: Asset at risk: the host and the guest. Actor class: an injected AI choosing tool arguments, or a compromised guest. Prerequisites: control of a tool argument or of the guest. Rank 6. Full entry: docs/threat-model.md, K06.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Closed verb set with schemas; arguments passed as vectors, never shell strings; option-like values rejected; names of snapshots and domains from configuration; length limits; guest accepts only schema-valid messages; host treats guest output as untrusted. Verification: Planned test: hostile-argument fixtures against every verb, rejected before any process starts, with a stub that fails if one is spawned; fuzz of the host-side guest-message parser. Residual: Parser bugs remain possible; keep the channel small and review it first. Status is Open: the design is not built; every verification marked planned is a Phase 1 test.

data.name: Fetch request into the sandbox
data.description: Destination plus caps; revert and screenshot verbs.

data.name: Text envelope out of the sandbox
data.description: Length-capped UTF-8 text; host validates only.

threats.title: K11: Hostile bytes parsed in the core
threats.description: Asset at risk: the host process that receives sandbox output. Actor class: a page author or a malformed server response. Prerequisites: a page or response. Rank 11. Full entry: docs/threat-model.md, K11.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Parse and sanitize inside the sandbox; host validates only a bounded UTF-8 envelope; memory-safe language and maintained parser; limits on nesting, size and decompression ratio; unknown encodings refused. Verification: Planned property and fuzz tests with time and memory budgets; a bomb fixture that must stop at the cap. Residual: A sandbox-contained parser bug can still forge output. Status is Open: the design is not built; every verification marked planned is a Phase 1 test.

data.name: Request on the network
data.description: Tor or I2P traffic to the destination.

threats.title: K13: Data leakage by distinguishability: the tool is spotted or cloaked against
threats.description: Asset at risk: unlinkability and the quality of results. Actor class: an operator who profiles visitors. Prerequisites: an operator who profiles visitors. Rank 13. Full entry: docs/threat-model.md, K13.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Stock browser settings where possible; one profile per network; jittered cadence and low request count; accept that a text-only reader differs from a person. Verification: Manual review only (inferred); no test claims this. Residual: Accepted in part. Status is Open: the design is not built; every verification marked planned is a Phase 1 test.

data.name: Page bytes
data.description: Hostile content: text, markup, oversize, redirects.

threats.title: K05: Abusive content met, stored or transcribed
threats.description: Asset at risk: the maintainer's legal and personal safety. Actor class: no attacker needed; any fetched page. Prerequisites: fetching a page. Rank 5. Full entry: docs/threat-model.md, K05.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Owned by the Phase 2 safety gate (#4): abuse filter, stop-and-report, purge, reporting channel. Phase 1: text only, no images or files, caps, no page body persisted, size-limited tmpfs destroyed at end of run. The consumer transcript is outside Knight Rider's storage. Verification: Planned test: a run leaves no page body on any persistent path and non-text types are refused. The gate's own checks belong to #4, not yet approved. Residual: Gate not yet written; discovery must not run until it is. Transcript retention cannot be controlled from here. Status is Open: the design is not built; every verification marked planned is a Phase 1 test.

threats.title: K15: Resource exhaustion by a page or server
threats.description: Asset at risk: availability, disk and quota. Actor class: a page author or a slow or hostile server. Prerequisites: a page or server. Rank 15. Full entry: docs/threat-model.md, K15.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Byte cap enforced while streaming; wall-clock cap per request and run; redirect cap; concurrency limit; text-type allowlist; size-limited tmpfs; kill and revert on breach. Verification: Planned test against a stub server that streams forever, trickles, loops and sends a bomb; each stops at the cap with a distinct error. Residual: Low. Status is Open: the design is not built; every verification marked planned is a Phase 1 test.

threats.title: K09: Supply chain: browser, daemons, images and dependencies
threats.description: Asset at risk: the sandbox and, through K02, the host. Actor class: a compromised or neglected upstream release or download path. Prerequisites: an upstream compromise, or neglect of updates. Rank 9. Full entry: docs/threat-model.md, K09.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Images pinned by digest; downloads verified against vendor signatures with the procedure and date written down; no floating tags; scanning through the GYST security workflow; scheduled updates with recorded dates. Verification: Planned CI check failing on an unpinned image or floating tag. Command: grep -rnE ':latest|@sha256:' on the image definitions shows only pinned references. Existing security and Dependabot checks. Residual: A compromised signing key or a zero-day. Status is Open: the design is not built; every verification marked planned is a Phase 1 test.
